# まだ vs もう — still vs already

**[まだ](<../grammar/もう・まだ.md#まだ>)**
:   The situation has not changed yet: まだ食べています (still eating)・まだ食べていません (not yet)。Use it while the expected change is pending.

**[もう](<../grammar/もう・まだ.md#もう>)**
:   The change has happened: もう食べました (already)・もう食べません (not anymore)。Also 'another': もう一つ。Where まだ says unchanged, もう says changed.
